lane: فَاثِجٌ , applied to a she-camel, _Pregnant;_ (As, S, O, K;) and so فَاسِجٌ: (As, S:) or _youthful, and having conceived:_ (As, S:) or _having conceived, and become goodly:_ (AO, S:) or _having conceived, and become fat, being youthful:_ (TA:) pl. فَوَاثِجُ. (S, O.) And, so applied, _i. q._ حَائِلٌ [i. e. One _not conceiving during a year,_ or _two years,_ or _some years_], _and fat:_ (O, K:) thus having two contr. significations. (K.) And, (K,) accord. to IDrd, (O,) A she-camel _having a large hump, and fat;_ (O, K;) and _so though she be not_ حَائِل. (O.)

entries.text: الفاثج: الناقة الحامل، والحائل السمينة، ضد، والكوماء السمينة. وفثج: نقص، و الماء الحار بالبارد: كسر حره، وأثقل، كفثج. وأفثج: ترك، وأعيا، وانبهر، كأفثج، بالضم.
